facts.fact: 七十二小时前：Johnny 被一名男子领养，临别抱着 foster 妹妹 Sarah 叮嘱她保持强悍、杀回他身边。
facts.anchor: You keep being a badass bitch and fight your way back to me

facts.fact: Sarah 被 Gage 扯开、被 Ethan 接住，Ethan 愤怒起誓一定会把 Johnny 找回来，说这只是暂时的。
facts.anchor: I swear to fuck we’ll find him. I don’t care how. We will. I swear it to you

facts.fact: Sarah 的崩溃清单：一个月内接连失去 Baby Blue、Caleb，现在又是 Johnny——她以为他们建成了小小的永远家庭。
facts.anchor: First with Baby Blue. Then my Caleb. Now Johnny? All within a month

facts.fact: Sarah 把脸埋进 Ethan 颈间的疤痕区——他童年火灾留下的伤，他破了自己「不许碰伤疤」的铁律。
facts.anchor: no touching what he considered a deformity—the damage from the fire

facts.fact: 挣扎中 Sarah 幻听到一声「Beloved」，年轻男人不会这样称呼她——她认定是 Baby Blue 的存在。
facts.anchor: I even imagined hearing a whisper, “Beloved,”

facts.fact: 领养人名字是 Styx——Johnny 噩梦里哭喊的名字；Sarah 只能在心里默祷请他善待朋友。
facts.anchor: Styx. A name Johnny knew and would cry for in his nightmares

facts.fact: 淋浴时水泛起星光般的sparkle，Sarah 想起 Johnny 前夜承认见过这种水；喊 Ethan 进来验证，两人都看得见。
facts.anchor: as if I were bathing in dancing stars

facts.fact: 两人推断这是血誓的效果：火花水让 Sarah 感觉与 Johnny 相连，Ethan 提出追问并要设法联系 Johnny。
facts.anchor: It was the water. The sparkles. They connected me to Johnny
